en: A black-and-white photograph showing a bustling square with vintage cars and people in early 20th-century attire. The foreground features a cobblestone street and a group gathered outside a building labeled 'Stadshallar.' Flags are raised above the building. In the background, a notable round tower is seen atop a hill, surrounded by trees and remnants of a larger stone fortification.
